note: After the original description by Ahmad (1965) (in English). Only the soldier is described; the alate and worker are not. The holotype was collected at Wang Nok An, Thailand, under dry elephant dung, and the paratypes in an Amitermes nest at Huay Yang. The original was extracted by OCR from the Internet Archive scan; the measurements have been checked.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head smoke-brown, the vertex pale yellowish brown; nasus dark brown, distinctly darker than the head; antennae pale yellowish brown, the basal 2 segments much paler than the rest; pronotum brown, the posterior lobe paler with a brownish tinge; mesonotum and metanotum concolorous with the posterior lobe of the pronotum; abdominal tergites pale brown; legs straw-yellow. Head covered with numerous short hairs and a few scattered long setae; nasus as densely hairy as the head; pronotum sparsely hairy; abdominal tergites with numerous short hairs and a few long setae; sternites densely covered with short hairs. Head pyriform in dorsal view, longer than wide; dorsal outline almost straight; frontal hump very weak; nasus cylindrical, longer than half the head capsule. Apical process of the mandibles short. Antennae 11-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum not concave.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm). Soldier (8 individuals, holotype/range/mean): head with nasus 1.01/1.01—1.06/1.03; head length without nasus 0.65/0.59—0.65/0.61; head width 0.49/0.49—0.57/0.52; head height 0.33/0.32—0.36/0.35; pronotum length 0.10/0.10/0.10, width 0.26/0.26—0.28/0.27.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Very close to N. parvus Light & Wilson from the Philippines, from which it differs by the smaller size, paler colour, more projecting mandibular apices and the absence of processes on either side of the base of the nasus. The small soldiers of N. dimorphus are very similar, but have 12 antennal segments (11 in this species).
